_doc: Temperament: how personality traits play out (TemperamentManager.gd; LIVING_WORLD.md I). scenes = daily trait-driven moments between adventurers in town (and sometimes you); battle = how companions fight by temperament; growth = experiences that change traits; voice = lines by trait, mixed with archetype lines.

tend_wounded.news: {actor} sat up all night with the injured {target}.

tend_you.news: {actor} changed your bandages without being asked. (An injury heals a day sooner.)

pickpocket.news: {target} caught {actor} with a hand in their purse.

pickpocket_you.news: Your purse feels lighter. You saw {actor} slip away from the bar. (-{amount})

brag.news: {actor} told the story of their last job again. It has grown another troll.

teach.news: {actor} spent the evening teaching {target} the weak points of every beast in the Bestiary.

celebrate.news: {actor} threw a party for {honoree}. The Tavern will be cleaning up for days.

mediate.news: {actor} sat {a} and {b} down and made them talk it out.

spar.news: {actor} challenged {target} to a sparring match behind the Guild. {winner} won.

freeload.news: {actor} has been drinking on {target}'s tab again.

seek_protection.news: {actor} has been following {target} around like a shadow.

battle._doc: Companions (and NPCs in real fights) by temperament: cowardly may freeze at low HP; loyal/kind heal you or allies early; cautious guards when hurt; reckless never guards; cruel finishes the weakest; lazy sometimes just swings.

growth.news: {name} dragged a friend out of the depths. Whatever they are now, they're not a coward.
Two near-deaths later, {name} checks the corners now.
{name} has been wronged once too often. They keep to themselves now.
{name} was saved by someone they'd mocked. They've been quieter since.
{name} watched one too many people pass them by. They're up before dawn now.
After two public beatings, {name}'s stories have shrunk.
{name} reached the top and found they could finally relax.
{name} came back from the brink praying.
{name} has caught the bug for books.
{name} owes their life to a friend - and they know it.
{name} has started splitting the loot evenly.
{name} doesn't laugh the way they used to.
{name} has started passing on what was done to them.

greeting: Heard there's something big on the deep floors. You in?
chat: Planning's for people who don't trust their sword.
I nearly died last week. Best week in months.
battle_start: Out of my way - I'm going first!
Let's do this the fast way!

greeting: Did you check your gear? Check it again.
chat: The ones who live longest are the ones who leave early.
Count your potions before you count your gold.
victory: Good. Now we rest before we push.

greeting: Have you seen the Ledger this week?
chat: Second place is the first loser. Someone said that. Probably me.
One day the Champion's seat will have my name on it.
battle_start: This one counts for the Ledger.
Watch closely - this is how it's done.
low_hp: Not here. Not before the top.

greeting: Buying? Selling? Lending at fair rates?
You look like someone with coin.
chat: Everything has a price. Everything.
The dead don't need their purses. Just saying.
battle_start: Mind the loot - don't break anything valuable.
Whatever drops is mine. Kidding. Mostly.
low_hp: I'm not dying before I spend it all!

greeting: There you are. I was starting to worry.
chat: You stand by your friends. That's all there is to it.
I'd walk into the deep floors for the people I care about.
battle_start: Stay close. I'm not losing anyone today.
victory: Told you I'd keep you safe.
low_hp: Don't worry about me - keep going!
I can still stand. I'll stand.

greeting: Good evening. I hope the day treated you fairly.
chat: A promise is a debt. I pay my debts.
There's no glory in a dishonest win.
battle_start: Fight well. That's all I ask.

greeting: Is it safe? It looks safe. Is it?
chat: I'm not scared. I'm... cautious. Very cautious.
Did you hear that? No? Good. Good.
battle_start: I'll be right behind you. Way behind you.
victory: Is it over? It's over? I knew we'd win!
I wasn't scared. Not even a little.
low_hp: I don't want to die here!

greeting: You look tired. Are you alright?
chat: Everyone's carrying something. Help where you can.
I had a spare potion, so I gave it away. Of course I did.
victory: Is anyone hurt? Let me see.
We all made it. That's what matters.
low_hp: Don't mind me - help the others first.

chat: The weak exist to make the strong look good.
I like it when they beg. Is that strange?
battle_start: Let's see what they're made of. Inside.

chat: Why do today what someone else might do tomorrow?
I work smart. Or at least rarely.
battle_start: Fine. Fine. Let's get it over with.
victory: Wake me for the next one.
low_hp: I should have stayed in bed.

chat: Life's short. Laugh loud.
Did you hear the one about the goblin and the bard?
victory: Did you see that? That was amazing!

chat: I prefer my own company.
People talk too much.

greeting: May the Ancient Ones watch over you.
chat: Every dawn is a gift. Even the hard ones.
I prayed for you last night. I pray for everyone.
victory: The gods were with us today.
low_hp: If this is my hour, I'm ready.

greeting: Did you know trolls regenerate faster in the damp?
Ah, a fellow seeker of knowledge. Or a fighter. Either way.
chat: I've catalogued forty-one kinds of slime. Forty-two if you count the angry one.
Theory first, swords second.
battle_start: Fascinating specimen. Weak to fire, I'd wager.
victory: Exactly as predicted. More or less.
low_hp: This was not in the literature!

greeting: Ah! You've heard of me, of course.
Did I tell you about the time I killed a troll bare-handed?
chat: They'll write songs about me one day. I've started a few myself.
Modesty is for people with nothing to brag about.
battle_start: Stand back and watch a legend at work!
victory: Did everyone see that? Tell them I did it.
low_hp: A flesh wound! For the story!
This only makes the tale better.
